description: A tiny focus/Pomodoro timer for the Windows tray that mutes notifications while you work.
notes: Run 'taskbar-focus' to start it. It lives in the notification area - click the ^ arrow and drag the icon onto the taskbar to keep it visible.
Settings are kept in %APPDATA%\taskbar-focus and are not removed when you uninstall. Delete that folder to remove them.
Run 'taskbar-focus --explain' to see exactly what it does to your system.
